description: Supermodel 0.3a [ Global ] input keys -> logical controls. Input mappings are global only in Supermodel (per-game sections are ignored for inputs). Values: JOYn_XAXIS/YAXIS/ZAXIS/RXAXIS/RYAXIS/RZAXIS/SLIDER1/SLIDER2 (+ _POS/_NEG half, _INV inverted), JOYn_BUTTONk (1-based), JOYn_POVm_UP/DOWN/LEFT/RIGHT (1-based). n = DirectInput enumeration order (WheelMap -Detect shows it as JOYn). Unmapped keys keep their current value.
settingsNote: Extra [ Global ] lines written as they are; {wheel} is the wheel's JOY number on the cabinet. InputJoyNXSaturation = 40: full lock at 40 % of the wheel's travel, about 180 degrees each way on a 900-degree G29 (James on RACE2, 2026-11-27, Dirt Devils: "need more sensitivity on turning degrees", then "Race2 perfect"). It applies to every Model 3 game.
pedalStyleNote: auto = decide from the captured travel: pedals resting near the centre use the pressed half (JOYn_YAXIS_NEG/_POS, what the previous owner's G29 file uses); pedals resting at one end use the whole axis (JOYn_YAXIS_INV when pressing lowers the value). half / full force one form.

games.daytona2: Daytona USA 2 - 4-speed H (InputGearShift1-4) or paddles, VR1-4. Force feedback via DirectInput (ForceFeedback=1).
games.dayto2pe: Daytona USA 2 Power Edition - as daytona2.
games.swtrilgy: Star Wars Trilogy - analog joystick (InputAnalogJoyX/Y) + trigger/event buttons.
